$comment: VAPP-106: the size budgets release/size.ts --check gates (bytes; gzip where a browser downloads it). Every entry of sizes.json has one, a little above the number on record, so a pull request that grows the SDK past it fails exponential-ui.yml; a change that shrinks something lowers its budget in the same commit (the ratchet). Keys: npm = <package>/<entry> (minified, the entry plus the chunks it imports; <package>/styles.css = a web renderer's stylesheet as built, <package>/standalone.js = the element's self-contained file), xcframework/<slice>, android/<abi>, crate/<host>/<artifact>. Doubled per Danny 2026-10-26: budgets were tripping CI on every small change; every budget = 2× its measured size (CI where measured, else sizes.json; the per-machine overrides 2× their measure = budget / 1.025), so the check still fails a real blow-up past 2×.
